## Checklist

- [ ] `mkdocs build --strict` passes (`pip install -r requirements.txt` first)
- [ ] New pages are added to `nav:` in `mkdocs.yml` — otherwise they build but nobody can find them
- [ ] Links are relative (`../toolbox/archiving.md`), so both GitHub and the built site work
- [ ] No code added — no install scripts, IOC templates or Dockerfiles ([why](../CONTRIBUTING.md))
- [ ] Nothing safety-related: no guidance on designing interlocks, personnel protection or machine protection logic
- [ ] If a Helios Light Source number changed, I grepped for it and fixed the other pages that cite it
